instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. In front of a wooden house, the man in the purple hoodie (R1) stands in the center foreground with arms crossed, smiling at the camera. Behind him, the woman in the yellow sweatshirt (R2) hugs him from behind, wrapping her arms over his shoulders and chest while smiling warmly with her eyes open. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene with warm tones.
